scope: Known-scene behavioral engineering screen; no population confidence or held-out generalization claim.

definitions.active_transition: Agent active in reset/previous info.active_mask; includes own terminating step, excludes all later rows.
definitions.speed: Post-step reward_diagnostics.speed_mps, converted to km/h; active-transition weighted pooled summaries.
definitions.duration: Count of qualifying active transitions times fixed_delta timestep; discrete sampling, not interpolated crossing duration.
definitions.arrival: First success_event on an active transition; completion may be below 1 because rectangular goal zones terminate early.
definitions.first_motion: First post-step speed at or above resolved-config startup_speed_mps; includes rolling starts.
definitions.pace_reward: Sum of recorded reward component only; no counterfactual rescoring of the trace.
definitions.physical_jerk: Not computed; command changes are not physical jerk.
definitions.first_arrival: Observed partner completion/speed at first success; does not infer waiting intentions.
